source: Ported from the deep-review campaign branch review/numbduck-2026-06-29 (fork PR #50). utils.py/pybridge.py on origin/main are pristine upstream (Stage 1 did not touch them), so each task's code is snapped from its campaign commit; final code equals the CI-green campaign tip by construction.
upstreamPrBranch: upstream-pr/stage2 (base upstream/main) — built later by cherry-pick, per-PR approval required
order: T2 -> T9 -> T10 -> T11 -> review-hardening -> pin-expansion

tasks.title: Dual-runtime coordination guard
tasks.detail: load_duckdb compares a standalone libduckdb duckdb_library_version() vs the wheel version and refuses on mismatch; libraries_coordinated() + extract_connection_ptr refuse an uncoordinated runtime. utils.py + pybridge.py.

tasks.title: Fail-closed SHA-256 download integrity
tasks.detail: Pin per-version SHA-256 of libduckdb-osx-universal.zip; verify downloaded ZIP + cached dylib (sidecar) fail-closed; 0700/0600 perms; bounded timeout; symbol re-check. utils.py.

tasks.title: Loader refactor for testability
tasks.detail: Split _download_libduckdb into _consent_to_download + _fetch_and_cache(url,dest,sha) drivable via file://; EOF/non-TTY-safe consent; side-effect-free locator; end-anchored regexes; explicit legacy-cache migration. utils.py.

tasks.title: Pybridge input validation + docstring
tasks.detail: Null-guard the two walked pointers; exact-type-identity (not isinstance); RuntimeError on closed/null connection; corrected docstring (SELECT 1 = liveness smoke-test, borrowed-pointer lifetime contract). pybridge.py.

tasks.title: Fold in review hardening
tasks.detail: Snap utils.py/pybridge.py to campaign tip to fold the post-task review fixes: atomic os.replace cache staging (9e48b06), unique tempfile.mkstemp write to avoid concurrent-download race (c9e51e8), pybridge docstring trim (9d03b2a). Final code == campaign tip by construction.

tasks.title: Expand pin dict 3 -> 12 versions
tasks.detail: Expand _PINNED_LIBDUCKDB_SHA256 from the 3 CI versions to all 12 in-range (1.3.2..1.5.4), digests double-verified 2026-07-09 (reference_numbduck_libduckdb_sha256). macOS users on latest (1.5.4) else fail closed.

tasks.title: Full local gate
tasks.detail: Cache-cleared venv pytest, gating flake8 (E9,F63,F7,F82), doc-codeblock, lychee. Then adversarial verification of the security-critical guards (Sonnet floor).

tasks.title: Fork PR
tasks.detail: Push feat/upstream-stage2; open fork PR (bots review). Upstream PR only with per-PR approval.
